title: Governed profile frontmatter object
description: Closed, total schema for a .claude/agents/<profile>.md YAML frontmatter object (model-economy S3). The key set is exactly the projection of a manifest profile: additionalProperties:false admits only these keys, each fully typed. EFFORT and disallowedTools are optional at the schema layer (their per-profile presence is proven by whole-object projection equality against the manifest), everything else is required.
